_comment: At the start of your turn, destroy Blessing of Aether, then if the next card you play this turn has an arcane-damage effect, INSTEAD it deals that much +1. The 'next arcane damage +1' is the engine's Amp mechanic (CR 8.5.47). Modeled as START_OF_TURN -> DESTROY self + AMP 1. Prior JSON injected an ON_PLAY trigger with MODIFY_ATTACK (attack power, not arcane).
